summary: Final verification of /nabidka image stretch parity at desktop 1440x900. All 3 acceptance criteria PASS. Image bounding height equals item bounding height within 5px tolerance (0-2px diff = border-top width). 56px margin-top between items preserved, 0 for first child. Padding on .process-item is 0. min-height on .process-img is 0 — grid row is NOT pinned by image min-height; it's sized by intrinsic content of text column and image stretches via align-self:stretch.

measurements_at_1440x900.note: 1-2px diff between item bounding height and image height accounts for the 1px border-top (border-box vs grid track). Item 3 has 2px diff likely due to slight text wrap differences in last item. All within acceptance tolerance.

acceptance_criteria_results.gridTemplateRows_not_pinned_by_image_min: PASS (img min-height:0; row sized by intrinsic content of text column)

critical_code_review_comments: Computed gridTemplateRows shows pixel value (136.641px) but this is browser-computed track size from intrinsic text content, not from a fixed CSS rule — requirement satisfied since min-height:0 on img means no pinning.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 closes the Nabidka image-stretch issue. /app/frontend/src/App.css desktop @media >=700px: .process-item has padding:0, margin-top:56px (first-child:0), align-items:stretch; .process-img has min-height:0, align-self:stretch, aspect-ratio:auto. Items measured 136.64px tall with image filling exactly that height. Tested at viewport 1440x900 on /nabidka.
